title: 3. How model extraction works
summary: Attacker Sends many carefully selected queries ↓ Public model API Returns predictions or generated responses ↓ Collected input-output dataset ↓ Substitute model Attempts to approximate the original behavior This is sometimes called model stealing or black-box model extraction .
